palette: deep board green + chalk white + chalk yellow emphasis + chalk pink caution + chalk blue citation + warm wood tray
typography: hand-set chalk headings with double chalk underlines, dashed chalk frames for boxes, chalk-yellow chips for principles and chalk-blue chips for rules, pink reserved for warnings
composition: each scene is a board spread: the comparison sits as a chalk table with a wood chalk-tray header, the method stage splits into a switch board and a balance, the threshold gate draws as a dashed door with keys
surface: flat board green with faint chalk dust smears and eraser ghosting, dashed chalk strokes, solid wood tray strip at the bottom edge, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: chalk strokes draw themselves, chips get underlined as they are spoken, the switch flips once and holds, the balance pans settle, keys slide into the gate lock
transition: an eraser swipe ghosts the board clean before the next spread
